text: SUPERVISOR — bundle with your one-kit sculpt fix: the items SCULPT camera FAILS too. User verbatim: "the camera inside of the items sculpt is not the full camera approach still. i cant get close to the item at all". The lens must use THE full stage camera (the shared kit camera the character stage uses — orbit + wheel zoom with a near range that lets the user get right up close to item-scale objects; the camera-feel knobs already exist on the settings surface). No bespoke camera with clamped zoom. Min-zoom/near-clip for item scale are tuning data. Comes for free if your one-kit replacement consumes the character stage kit wholesale — verify zoom-to-close works on an item-sized mesh as part of that. The user nose-to-nose with their item is the PASS.
